dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric, gradual geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light-grey tone across the dorsal surface, categorized between juvenile slate-grey and mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters localized on the cranial region and mid-dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, linear dorsal ridge along the posterior half of the body, characterized by a distinct highlight-to-shadow gradient along the central axis.
